title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, bump actions, improve caching
author: Priya Ramanathan
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions landscape has accumulated many repo-specific variants of lint/test/release workflows which makes maintenance and cross-repo consistency hard. This PR unifies lint, test, and release automation into a small set of reusable workflows and action templates, upgrades a handful of community actions, and improves cache parallelism to reduce CI time and flakiness. Summary of changes: consolidates three workflow files into a single unified ci.yml with matrix support for node versions and package groups; extracts a build-matrix reusable template under .github/actions/templates; bumps actions/setup-node and actions/cache versions; standardizes environment variables and secrets usage across jobs; increases cache key namespace to avoid collisions between workspaces; tunes parallelism for lint/test jobs to stay under org-level concurrency quotas; introduces a README.CI.md describing patterns and how to onboard new repos; small package.json devDependency bumps for eslint/jest to match node matrix. Checklist: [x] consolidate workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml (reusable release job) [x] add actions/templates/build-matrix.yml [x] bump actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v4 [x] standardize cache keys and restore strategies [x] update README.CI.md and internal docs [x] run full CI across redwood, redwood-sdk-python and redwood-docs examples. Notes on scope: This is intentionally limited to workflow and build-tooling hygiene and non-breaking dev dependency bumps. No production runtime code was modified. Release automation change is additive: a reusable release job is provided but not enabled for all repos; maintainers must opt in by referencing the reusable job. Rollout steps: merged to main -> maintainers can flip on new workflow in repo settings if they want to opt out of legacy runs -> monitor CI duration and cache hit metrics in Console for 2 weeks.
commits: Initial consolidation: add .github/workflows/ci.yml and move job definitions
Add reusable build-matrix template and README.CI.md
Bump actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v4; update cache keys
Tweak matrix to include node 18/20 and split lint/test groups
Address reviewer feedback: reduce job parallelism, fix cache collision bug
Squash and final polish: update docs and changelog entry
review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice consolidation — can you explain the decision to keep node 18 in the matrix instead of dropping to 20-only?
Priya Ramanathan: We keeping node 18 for LTS compatibility with downstream customers and some CI images; plan to drop in a follow-up after telemetry shows low usage.
Sofia Martinez: Found a cache key collision when running in parallel on the runner fleet — suggest namespacing by repo and workflow_id.
Priya Ramanathan: Fixed in commit 'Tweak matrix to include node 18/20...' — added repo and workflow prefix to cache keys.
Diego Alvarez: CI runtime dropped ~24% in our smoke runs, approving pending green e2e.
release_notes: Refactor CI: unify lint/test/release workflows into a single reusable pattern
Bump actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v4 for improved performance and security
Introduce reusable build-matrix template to reduce duplication and speed up onboarding
